note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Table of contents -- renders: fixed section headings (Background, Terminology, Structure, etc.) and navigation controls
Page title bar -- renders: article title and language selector control
Left navigation tabs -- renders: fixed view tabs (Article, Talk)
Right navigation tabs -- renders: fixed view tabs (Read, View source, View history) and tools menu
Appearance settings -- renders: fixed font size, width, and theme options
Site subtitle -- renders: fixed text 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
Footer -- renders: fixed copyright notices, legal links, and site metadata
